metadata.title: Khovanov Homology in Connected Sums, Properties and Applications
metadata.abstract: We extend the definition of Khovanov-Lee homology to links in connected sums of interval bundles over surfaces and $S^1\times S^2$'s, and construct a Rasmussen-type invariant for links in these manifolds. As an application, we prove an inequality relating the Rasmussen-type invariant to the genus of surfaces with boundary in four-manifolds that are boundary connect sums of $D^2\times S^2$, $\mathbb{C} P^2\setminus B^4$, and $DTS^2$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 连通和中的 Khovanov–Lee 同调
analysis.workSummary: 将 Khovanov–Lee 同调扩展到曲面区间丛与 S¹×S² 的连通和中的链环，构造 Rasmussen 型不变量，并得到指定四维流形内有边界曲面的亏格不等式。
analysis.breakthrough: 为非 S³ 背景中的链环及四维曲面提供亏格约束。
analysis.limitations: 应用限定文中列出的边界连通和四维流形。
analysis.priorityReason: 为非 S³ 背景中的链环及四维曲面提供亏格约束。
